collection.selection: First9eligible pairs by ascending slot, permuted once with the fixed per-goal grouping seed, then partitioned into3disjointtriplets. No edited outcomes used.
collection.stop: First complete paired16block with9eligible, else cap48. Failed qualification retained; no replacement goal.

edit.alignment: Three opening template tokens plus common valid State/Action suffix; reject if not40pairs consistent across all9source states.
edit.recipe: Mean keys and clarified-minus-original residual increments over3states; one72row ridge solve perlayer;BF16 merge; no tuning

baselines.selection: Maximum original-request success on separate development layouts; ties choose smaller strength, including shared unedited zero. No held-out selection.
baselines.identity_gate: Fixed16 native zero-injection action parity and exact clarified-prefix positive control before any method evaluation.

evaluation.primary: Original request on fresh changed arrangements; report eachsourcegroup and goal separately.
evaluation.freeze: Seal runtime,candidates,developmentselection,and entireheldout schedule before firstheldout episode.

analysis.source_group_reporting: Report eachtriplet first; group mean/range descriptive. Shared baseline and layouts are not independent replication cohorts.
analysis.population_scope: 3historically informed repair goals,3fresh disjoint source groups each; qualification failures stay in denominator.

constraints: Do not modify completed cohorts or resume ICWM.
No held-out tuning,optional stopping,or goal replacement after qualification.
A technical stop preserves partial evidence and requires a separately recorded recovery decision.
Named source sets are disjoint,not separate independent baseline/layout cohorts.
Original/clarified collection has nominal scene/noise pairing,not pixel-identical rendered trajectories.
